svg.text: Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
the ⌖ shows a point on the map
★ The seek bar fills the free width of the main bar: drag = scrub, click = jump, hover = the time and frame. No ticks: the events are in the
Event Timeline below (R-4155). The Replay Timeline window's slider, frame / tick / path rows move here
(the frame into the tooltip, the file into File ▸ Recording info) and the window is retired (Q-B2).
★ A default Replay layout: map centre, Details docked right, the Event Timeline docked below full width — today all seven default windows
open stacked at one corner, four of them about 90 × 50 px (measured). The debug windows (inspectors, event browser, frame diff, federation, search)
start closed under View ▸ Windows ▸ Debug (Q-B3).
Q-R1 explained: after you JUMP (seek) from 0:12 to 0:40, the Details rows whose value differs between the two moments flash for a moment —
e.g. Position and Strength light up, Name does not — so you see what the jump changed. During normal play nothing flashes.
